sloka: अकस्माच्चाभिकामो ऽसि सीतां राक्षसपुङ्गव ।ऐश्वर्यस्य विनाशाय देहस्य स्वजनस्य च ।। ६.११४.२० ।।
transliteration: akasmāccābhikāmo 'si sītāṁ rākṣasapuṅgava ।aiśvaryasya vināśāya dehasya svajanasya ca ।। 6.114.20 ।।

translations.english: " At Janasthana when your brother Khara was surrounded by many Rakshasas also he got killed by a mortal. So also, when Hanuman entered the city of Lanka, which is difficult to enter even for gods, I got perturbed."
translations.hindi: हे तमोन्न ! हे हिमन्न ! हे शत्रन्न ! हे अमितात्मन्‌ ! हें कृतन्न ! हे देव ! हे ज्योतिषपते ! आपको प्रणाम है
